    chain_id: pub Field,
    protocol_address: pub Field,
    token_address: pub Field,
    chain_generation: pub Field,
    source_count: pub Field,
    sources_digest: pub Field,
    input_count: pub Field,
    operation_digest_hi: pub Field,

    input_digest: pub Field,
    binding: pub Field,
    owners: [Field; 10],
    nonces: [Field; 10],
    amounts: [Field; 10],

    leaf_indices: [u32; 10],
    paths: [[Field; 32]; 10],
    tree_ids: [u64; 10],
    roots: [Field; 10],
    leaf_counts: [u64; 10],
) {
    provenance_common::verify(
        [
            chain_id,
            protocol_address,
            token_address,

            source_count,

        leaf_indices,
        paths,
        tree_ids,
        roots,
        leaf_counts,
    );
}
